title: Ratatouille
description: A Provençal stew of eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes cooked slowly with garlic, thyme and olive oil until silky.
equipment: Large Dutch oven or deep skillet

image.alt: A pan of ratatouille with zucchini, eggplant, tomato and pepper

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the pot over medium-high heat. Brown the eggplant with a pinch of the salt, stirring now and then, until golden, {time 8 min}. Move to a bowl.
Add 1 tbsp more oil and brown the zucchini, {time 5 min}. Add it to the eggplant.
Add the rest of the oil, the onion and peppers and cook until soft, {time 8 min}. Add the garlic and thyme for {time 1 min}.
Add the tomatoes and the rest of the salt and simmer for {time 10 min}. Return the eggplant and zucchini and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, until everything is very tender, {time 20 min}.
Stir in the basil and taste for salt. Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread, rice or polenta.

notes: Cooking the vegetables separately first keeps them from turning to mush and lets each brown properly.
Ratatouille tastes even better the next day.
